head_commit.message:
Harden dependency Lean options and fail a dispatched run that is not admitted

- dependency_root_options takes the profile's source roots and refuses a solution
  dependency root that is a submission root, a Verifier* root or a reserved root. It
  fails at prepare, before the build (build_roots still refuses the last two in pack
  and unpack).
- lean_options accepts only the reviewed option names in LEAN_OPTION_NAMES
  (autoImplicit, relaxedAutoImplicit, exponentiation.threshold, pp.unicode.fun)
  instead of any name. Values stay boolean or non-negative integer.
- queue_lease.py acquire: on workflow_dispatch, a run that is not admitted prints
  "not admitted: lease held by run X" and ends failed. Before, it skipped verify and
  ended green (run 41101622070). Scheduled polls keep the quiet skip.

From the Integrations review of e6f6793 and the lead's decision of 2026-10-30.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
